title: Modify > Transform: Flip Horizontal, Flip Vertical, Rotate 90 CW/CCW
description: The Transform Panel exists but Modify > Transform submenu operations are missing: 'Flip Horizontal', 'Flip Vertical', 'Rotate 90° CW', 'Rotate 90° CCW', 'Rotate 180°'. These are simple geometric transforms that should apply to all selected display objects. Implement in Shell.tsx (handlers that multiply scaleX by -1 for flip, or add 90/180 to rotation) and add to MenuBar.tsx Modify > Transform submenu with standard Flash 8 keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+9 for Rotate 90 CW, etc.).
